name: Sania Mirza
bio:
Career Overview: Sania Mirza is India’s most celebrated female tennis player, a former world No. 1 in doubles and a six-time Grand Slam champion, who retired in February 2023.

Playing Style: Known for her powerful forehand, aggressive baseline play, and exceptional doubles instincts, Mirza excelled on all surfaces, particularly hard courts.

Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #27 (August 27, 2007)
Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #1 (April 13, 2015)

Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Reached the fourth round of the US Open in 2005.

Notable Achievements:
  • Won 6 Grand Slam titles: 3 in women’s doubles (2015 Wimbledon, 2015 US Open, 2016 Australian Open with Martina Hingis) and 3 in mixed doubles (2009 Australian Open, 2012 French Open, 2014 US Open).
  • Secured 1 WTA singles title (2005 Hyderabad Open) and 43 WTA doubles titles.
  • First Indian woman to win a WTA title and reach the doubles world No. 1 ranking.
  • Biggest Singles Win: Defeated then-World No. 9 Svetlana Kuznetsova at the 2005 Dubai Open.

Other Highlights:
  • Represented India at four Olympics (2008, 2012, 2016, 2020), reaching the mixed doubles semifinals in 2016 with Rohan Bopanna.
  • Inspired generations of Indian players and remains an icon for women’s sports in India.

Sania’s legacy as a trailblazer continues to shape Indian tennis post-retirement. 🎾🇮🇳
